channel.title: From the blog
channel.description: Learnings, recommendations & new features from ServiceStack engineers

item.title: Query JSON like any other property in OrmLite
item.author: demis@servicestack.com (Demis)
item.description: ServiceStack v10.4 lets typed OrmLite queries read straight into complex type properties with x.Address.City or x.Lines.Any(...), using the native JSON functions of SQLite, PostgreSQL, SQL Server and MySQL, plus a complete tour of everything else OrmLite can do with JSON

item.title: Advanced SQL queries in typed OrmLite
item.author: demis@servicestack.com (Demis)
item.description: ServiceStack v10.4 adds typed recursive queries, named sub queries, window functions with TopPerGroup, Union/Intersect/Except, SeekAfter keyset paging and async streaming, so the queries that used to need hand-written SQL stay typed, parameterized and portable

item.title: Safe SQL by default in OrmLite
item.author: demis@servicestack.com (Demis)
item.description: ServiceStack v10.4 adds Sql.Fmt() for interpolated SQL where every value is a db param, OrderBySafe() for user-selected sort orders, and stronger SQL injection protection across fragment validation, identifier quoting and inlined values

item.title: Keep your database in sync with your C# models
item.author: demis@servicestack.com (Demis)
item.description: ServiceStack v10.4 adds Schema Diff to OrmLite, which finds every difference between your C# models and their tables, from columns and types to defaults, indexes, foreign keys and constraints, then writes the migration for you to review, on SQLite, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MySQL and MariaDB

item.title: Prompt it, Publish it - AI-built works from your .NET APIs
item.author: demis@servicestack.com (Demis)
item.description: AI Chat puts a ChatGPT-like assistant inside your .NET App, where it calls the APIs the signed-in user is allowed to call and turns the results into interactive views and reports your team can explore, review and publish

item.title: Multitenancy that can't be forgotten
item.author: demis@servicestack.com (Demis)
item.description: ServiceStack v10.4 moves tenant isolation from every query to the database connection, with OrmLite connection filters and write rules that confine selects, updates, deletes, inserts and AutoQuery APIs to the request's tenant, fail closed until it's known, and record trusted audit columns on every write

item.title: Follow every request with OpenTelemetry
item.author: demis@servicestack.com (Demis)
item.description: ServiceStack v10.3 emits standard OpenTelemetry traces and metrics that follow a request from its API call through outbound HTTP calls, MQ messages and Background Jobs, even across servers, in Jaeger, Grafana Tempo, Honeycomb, Datadog or the .NET Aspire Dashboard

item.title: API Rate Limiting
item.author: demis@servicestack.com (Demis)
item.description: ServiceStack v10.3 adds opt-in ASP.NET Core rate limiting for ServiceStack APIs - bind a named policy to a Request DTO or share one budget across every API with the same Tag, enforced across every route an API can be called from

item.title: Software Licensing Next.js Project Template
item.author: demis@servicestack.com (Demis)
item.description: Next License is a new .NET 10, ServiceStack and Next.js 16 template for selling perpetual, offline-verified JWT licenses for your .NET and Electron desktop apps, with Stripe Checkout, GitHub-hosted downloads and an Operations Center, and no activation server to run

item.title: SaaS Next.js Project Template
item.author: demis@servicestack.com (Demis)
item.description: Next SaaS is a new production-ready .NET 10, ServiceStack and Next.js 16 template for multi-tenant B2C and B2B SaaS products, with organizations, Stripe subscriptions, versioned plans, usage quotas and an Operations Center included from day one
